rules.title: Checkout payment options
rules.statement: The inspected PlaceOrderAsync handles cash and cashier-confirmed static QR/bank transfers. It explicitly rejects QRIS gateway checkout and unallocated Split Bill. A cashier-confirmed transfer is not provider confirmation.

rules.title: Deferred invoice eligibility
rules.statement: The common IssueAsync path requires an active named customer for deferred settlement. It also validates tender amounts/currencies and rejects an empty cart; TakePaymentCommand delegates to that shared helper.

rules.title: Current Cafe service style
rules.statement: SqliteStoreProfileReader normalizes saved Table Service to Counter Service; the view-model toggle states Counter Service is fixed. Current Cafe checkout must be distinguished from legacy/backend order and kitchen queue code.

rules.title: Expense photo preparation and storage
rules.statement: Photo preparation accepts JPEG/PNG signatures, limits input to 10 MiB and decoded size to 12 megapixels, resizes the longest side to at most 1600 px, and limits prepared output to 2 MiB. Prepared bytes are validated and stored in expense_attachments.image_data with attachment version/replacement metadata.

rules.title: Non-cash waste expense payments
rules.statement: PayExpenseCommand validates revision/cancellation and explicitly rejects a non-cash expense with NON_CASH_EXPENSE_CANNOT_BE_PAID. Recording inventory waste does not imply a payable cash expense.

rules.title: Advance payment checks
rules.statement: PayAdvanceCommand requires person/account IDs, a positive amount and reason. It checks that the person exists, is enabled and matches ExpectedPersonRevision before continuing to account validation.

rules.title: Settings authority and monetary identity
rules.statement: ApplySettingsCommandHandler requires a live active Admin role. It blocks changing currency/monetary precision when the checked monetary records exist, and writes tax_mode=2 for the exclusive-tax policy. TaxMode in the command shape is not evidence of a freely selectable policy.

rules.title: Inventory loss delegates to adjustment
rules.statement: RecordInventoryLossCommand validates positive quantity, allowed reason and explanation, then calls InventoryCommandHandler with a negative AdjustStockCommand sharing the UnitOfWork. The loss result is read from inventory_loss_records for that movement.

rules.title: Kitchen queue is not physical output
rules.statement: KitchenTicket and KitchenTicketCancel are produced by order handlers. The bundled worker claim SQL selects only receipt, drawer and shelf-label jobs. The missing consumer is PP-REV-008.

rules.title: Exclusive tax, cash rounding tie rule, and pricing floor presets
rules.statement: CartCalculationService and SaleCommandHandler enforce exclusive tax (TaxMode 2) for new carts, compute service-charge tax share on the discounted net line base, and apply configurable cash rounding tie rules (even vs up, persisted via migration 084_CashRoundingTieRule.sql). PricingCalculationEngine.RoundToIncrement uses floor-to-increment semantics with UI presets 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000, and 10000.
